name: Clinora Logo (White)
tagline: White/reversed SVG wordmark for Clinora, for dark backgrounds
description: The reversed (white) variant of the Clinora primary logo, served as a raw SVG from the production site. It is the mark to place on dark or photographic backgrounds where the default logo would disappear. Because it is vector, it scales to any size and its fill can be overridden in CSS. This is a house brand asset, not a third-party resource.
agent_guidance: Use this file, not the default logo, whenever the Clinora mark sits on a dark surface, a hero image, or an inverted footer. Reference it by URL or copy the SVG inline so you can drive its fill from a CSS custom property and keep it in sync with the theme. Do not recolor, stretch, or rebuild the mark from scratch — pull the real file.
why_it_matters: The reversed lockup is half of a usable logo pair, and its absence is the usual cause of an invisible mark on dark themes.

name: Clinora Favicon
tagline: ICO favicon for clinora.ai, browser tab and bookmark icon
description: The legacy ICO favicon served from the root of clinora.ai. Browsers request it automatically to draw the tab icon, the bookmark entry, and the history list. It is a small raster derivative of the Clinora mark, not an independent design. This is a house brand asset with no reuse value outside Clinora properties.
agent_guidance: Treat this as an existence check, not a design source: if you are rebuilding the Clinora site, keep /favicon.ico at the root for old browsers and crawlers, but author the real icon as SVG plus a 180px PNG and let this be the fallback. Do not upscale the ICO for any other use — go back to clinora-logo.svg. If you regenerate it, regenerate the apple-touch-icon in the same pass so the set stays consistent.
why_it_matters: Catalogued for completeness of the Clinora asset set; it carries no design information the source SVG does not.

name: Clinora Apple Touch Icon
tagline: PNG home-screen icon for clinora.ai on iOS and iPadOS
description: The apple-touch-icon PNG served from the root of clinora.ai. iOS and iPadOS use it when a visitor adds the site to the home screen, and Safari uses it in some bookmark surfaces. Apple applies its own corner masking, so the artwork is a full-bleed square derived from the Clinora mark. This is a house brand asset, not a reusable icon set.
agent_guidance: Keep this at the site root and reference it with <link rel="apple-touch-icon">; iOS also probes the root path directly, so do not move it into an assets folder without leaving a redirect. Author it at 180x180 with an opaque background and no pre-rounded corners, because Apple masks the shape itself and a transparent PNG turns black on the home screen. It must visually match the favicon and the manifest icons.
why_it_matters: Part of the Clinora icon set; useful only as the reference for what the iOS home-screen tile currently looks like.

name: Clinora Noise Texture
tagline: Tiling grain PNG used as a background overlay on clinora.ai
description: The noise/grain PNG that clinora.ai layers over its backgrounds. Overlaid at low opacity it breaks up flat fills and gradients, hides colour banding, and gives large surfaces a printed rather than digital feel. It is a small tiling raster meant for background-repeat, not a foreground image. This is a house brand asset.
agent_guidance: Apply it as a repeating background on a pseudo-element above the fill and below the content, at roughly 3-8% opacity with pointer-events: none, rather than as a real background-image on the element itself. Two traps: it is a fixed-pixel raster, so on a 2x display set an explicit background-size or the grain doubles in scale and reads as mush; and full-viewport grain plus a blur or backdrop-filter is a real paint cost on mobile. If you only need subtle grain, an inline SVG feTurbulence is cheaper than shipping this PNG.
why_it_matters: The grain overlay is a large part of the Clinora look, and it is the one asset here that is genuinely reusable across other surfaces.

name: Clinora Web Manifest
tagline: PWA manifest for clinora.ai: name, icons, colors, display mode
description: The site.webmanifest JSON that makes clinora.ai installable as a progressive web app. It declares the app name and short name, the icon set and their sizes, the start URL, the display mode, and the theme and background colours the OS paints during launch. It is configuration, not artwork — but the theme_color and background_color in it are brand values that must match the CSS. This is a house brand asset.
agent_guidance: Read this file first when you need Clinora's canonical app name, theme colour, and icon inventory in one place — it is the closest thing in this set to a machine-readable brand token export. When you edit it, keep theme_color in step with the CSS and with the <meta name="theme-color"> tag, because the manifest value is what Android paints on the splash screen and a drift between the two is visible. Also confirm every icon path it lists actually resolves; a stale entry silently downgrades the install prompt.
why_it_matters: It is the one file that ties the Clinora icon set, name, and brand colours together, so it doubles as the manifest of the whole asset group.
